notice: These excerpts explain the contract, not FE fallback data. Full runtime envelopes are defined by p12-mixed-documents-openapi.json. Never send angle-bracket placeholders literally. Authentication and warehouse confirmation use existing owner flows. No write requests appear here.

common.scope: Warehouse comes from confirmed server context; optional warehouse_id must match.

examples.name: INBOUND_TAB
examples.rule: q matches explicit type terms or owner searchable fields. Other authorized source facets are evaluated before the selected tab.

examples.name: OUTBOUND_TAB
examples.rule: Search recipient_name with Unicode NFC/case folding, preserve accents, and count before LIMIT.

examples.name: EQUAL_TIMESTAMP_AND_UUID_IN_ASC_OR_DESC
examples.rule: For equal created_at, both variants return INBOUND before OUTBOUND before WARRANTY; IDs ascend within a source. Same UUID across sources is a different row_key. Follow a new cursor chain for each sort.

examples.name: NULL_TIME
examples.rule: Last in both directions; excluded by an explicit date filter, never replaced by current time.

examples.name: DENIED_SOURCE_IN_ALL
examples.rule: Do not display DENIED as zero or expose actual count.

examples.name: AUTHORIZED_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE
examples.rule: No rows/total from other sources are returned as a complete result; do not fallback to groups/fixtures.

examples.name: EXPIRED_CURSOR
examples.recovery: Start a new GET without cursor; fixed TTL is 15 minutes and never slides.

examples.name: CHANGED_CONTEXT
examples.recovery: Discard old cursor/cache for the previous context; confirm server context and restart the read. Never replay owner writes.

examples.name: VIETNAM_DATE_WINDOW
examples.rule: Select local 2026-10-09 00:00 inclusive to 2026-10-10 00:00 exclusive. Both selected dates must fall within first-request Vietnam today-90..today. For all dates omit both bounds.

examples.name: CANONICAL_DETAIL_TARGET
examples.rule: Use the actual response target; owner GET must revalidate ACL/context. This example does not assert these UUIDs exist.
